Container.Name: ironwail-addons
Container.Overview: Ironwail-compatible Quake add-on catalog manager with a browser admin UI, upload workflow, static public catalog, and package hosting for Ironwail's built-in add-ons menu. This image is published automatically from the GitHub repository.
Container.Requires: Image is published automatically to GHCR on repo pushes. No manual image build is required before installation.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the Flask app HTTP port inside the container.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Persistent application state and SQLite database.

Config.Name: Public Catalog Path
Config.Description: Public static catalog and downloadable package directory served by the app.

Config.Name: Upload Cache Path
Config.Description: Temporary upload and staging directory for admin uploads.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Secret used for Flask sessions and admin authentication. Change before first use.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Externally reachable base URL used for published catalogs and admin links. Use your HTTPS reverse proxy URL if TLS is terminated in front of the container.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Container HTTP port used by the Flask process.

Config.Name: PERSIST_ROOT
Config.Description: Persistent database and metadata directory inside the container.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_ROOT
Config.Description: Public static catalog/download directory inside the container.

Config.Name: UPLOAD_FOLDER
Config.Description: Temporary upload and staging directory inside the container.
